data.longBusinessSummary: Fanuc Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance services of products used in automated production systems in Japan, the United States, Europe, China, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers CNC series, robots, and robomachine products, such as servo motors, lasers, compact machining centers, electric injection molding machines, wire electrical discharge machines, system basic package, and AI servo monitors. Fanuc Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Yamanashi, Japan.
